Aspid.FastTools.Enums.EnumValues<TEnum, TValue>
    public sealed class EnumValues<TEnum, TValue> : System.Collections.Generic.IEnumerable<System.Collections.Generic.KeyValuePair<TEnum, TValue>>, System.Collections.IEnumerable, UnityEngine.ISerializationCallbackReceiver where TEnum : struct, System.Enum
    public EnumValues()
    public bool Equals(TEnum enumValue1, TEnum enumValue2)
    public Aspid.FastTools.Enums.EnumValuesEnumerator<TEnum, TValue> GetEnumerator()
    public TValue GetValue(TEnum enumValue)

Aspid.FastTools.Enums.EnumValues<TValue>
    public sealed class EnumValues<TValue> : System.Collections.Generic.IEnumerable<System.Collections.Generic.KeyValuePair<System.Enum, TValue>>, System.Collections.IEnumerable, UnityEngine.ISerializationCallbackReceiver
    public EnumValues()
    public bool Equals(System.Enum enumValue1, System.Enum enumValue2)
    public Aspid.FastTools.Enums.EnumValuesEnumerator<System.Enum, TValue> GetEnumerator()
    public TValue GetValue(System.Enum enumValue)

Aspid.FastTools.Enums.EnumValuesEnumerator<TKey, TValue>
    public struct EnumValuesEnumerator<TKey, TValue> : System.Collections.Generic.IEnumerator<System.Collections.Generic.KeyValuePair<TKey, TValue>>, System.Collections.IEnumerator, System.IDisposable

    public bool MoveNext()
